functions.activate_novamira_pro_license:
def activate_novamira_pro_license(site: dict, license_key: str) -> None:
    php = (
        "if (!function_exists('Novamira\\\\Pro\\\\activate_new_license_key')) { "
        "echo 'not applicable'; return; } "
        "$result = \\Novamira\\Pro\\activate_new_license_key("
        + json.dumps(license_key)
        + "); if (!$result[0]) { WP_CLI::error($result[1]); }"
    )
    result = _wp(site["slug"], "eval", php)
    status = "Licence Novamira Pro non applicable" if "not applicable" in (getattr(result, "stdout", "") or "") else "Licence Novamira Pro activée"
    models.log_site(site["slug"], "info", status)
functions.provision_mcp:
def provision_mcp(site: dict) -> None:
    """Configure le MCP sans rendre indisponible un WordPress correctement créé."""
    try:
        enable_novamira_abilities(site)
        create_mcp_credentials(site)
        validate_mcp_connection(site)
    except Exception as exc:
        error = format_mcp_error(exc)
        models.update_mcp_health(site["slug"], status="error", error=error)
        models.log_site(
            site["slug"],
            "warn",
            f"MCP indisponible : {error}. WordPress reste disponible.",
        )
functions.create_site:
def create_site(name: str, template_slug: str, php_version: str | None = None,
                client_name: str | None = None,
                target_domain: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Crée la ligne DB et renvoie le row. Provisioning lancé en background."""
    template = get_template(template_slug)
    php_version = php_version or template["default_php"]
    if php_version not in _php_values():
        raise ValueError(f"Version PHP non supportée : {php_version}")

    slug = slugify(name)
    if models.get_site(slug):
        raise ValueError(f"Un site avec le slug '{slug}' existe déjà")

    site = {
        "slug": slug,
        "name": name,
        "profile": template["category"],  # sandbox / project (dérivé)
        "template_slug": template_slug,
        "client_name": client_name,
        "target_domain": target_domain,
        "port": alloc_port(),
        "php_version": php_version,
        "status": "creating",
        "notes": "",
        "wp_admin_user": "admin",
        "wp_admin_password": gen_password(12),
        "db_password": gen_password(16),
        "db_root_password": gen_password(20),
        "created_at": models.now_iso(),
    }
    models.insert_site(site)
    models.log_site(slug, "info", f"Site créé en DB · template {template_slug} · port {site['port']} · PHP {php_version}")
    return site
functions._provision_site:
def _provision_site(site: dict) -> None:
    slug = site["slug"]
    template = get_template(site["template_slug"]) if site.get("template_slug") else None
    _make_site_dirs(slug)

    models.log_site(slug, "info", f"Vérification image WP PHP {site['php_version']}…")
    ensure_wp_image_built(site["php_version"])
    ensure_staging_network()

    _render_compose(site)
    models.log_site(slug, "info", "docker-compose.yml généré")

    _compose(slug, "up", "-d")
    models.log_site(slug, "info", "Containers démarrés, attente WP…")

    _wait_for_wp(slug, max_seconds=240)
    models.log_site(slug, "info", "WP répond, install WordPress…")

    site_url = f"http://{config.NAS_HOST}:{site['port']}"
    admin_email = f"admin@{slug}.local"
    _wp(slug, "core", "install",
        f"--url={site_url}",
        f"--title={site['name']}",
        f"--admin_user={site['wp_admin_user']}",
        f"--admin_password={site['wp_admin_password']}",
        f"--admin_email={admin_email}",
        "--skip-email")
    models.log_site(slug, "info", "WP installé")

    if not template:
        return

    # Licence ACF Pro : constante posée AVANT l'install du plugin pour que
    # l'activation de la licence soit automatique au premier chargement.
    has_acf = any("advanced-custom-fields-pro" in z for z in template["premium_zips"])
    if has_acf and config.ACF_PRO_LICENSE:
        _wp(slug, "config", "set", "ACF_PRO_LICENSE",
            config.ACF_PRO_LICENSE, "--type=constant", check=False)
        models.log_site(slug, "info", "Constante ACF_PRO_LICENSE posée dans wp-config")
    elif has_acf:
        models.log_site(slug, "warn",
                        "ACF Pro dans le template mais ACF_PRO_LICENSE absent du .env")

    # Thème
    if template.get("theme"):
        _wp(slug, "theme", "install", template["theme"], "--activate", check=False)
        models.log_site(slug, "info", f"Thème installé : {template['theme']}")

    # Plugins free (repo WP)
    # Un plugin peut être épinglé à une version via la syntaxe "slug:version",
    # utile pour reproduire un bug client sur une version précise ou contourner
    # une incompatibilité entre un plugin du repo et un zip premium daté.
    # WP-CLI n'accepte --version que pour un seul plugin à la fois, d'où la
    # séparation en deux passes.
    if template["free_plugins"]:
        unpinned = [p for p in template["free_plugins"] if ":" not in p]
        pinned = [p for p in template["free_plugins"] if ":" in p]
        if unpinned:
            _wp(slug, "plugin", "install", *unpinned, "--activate")
        for spec in pinned:
            name, version = spec.split(":", 1)
            _wp(slug, "plugin", "install", name,
                f"--version={version}", "--force", "--activate")
        models.log_site(slug, "info", f"Plugins free installés : {template['free_plugins']}")

    # Plugins premium du template + Novamira, standard sur tous les stagings.
    premium_zips = list(dict.fromkeys([*template["premium_zips"], *_MCP_PLATFORM_ZIPS]))
    for zip_name in premium_zips:
        zip_path = f"/premium-plugins/{zip_name}"
        local_path = config.PLUGINS_DIR / zip_name
        if not local_path.exists():
            models.log_site(slug, "warn", f"Plugin premium absent : {zip_name} (skip)")
            continue
        _wp(slug, "plugin", "install", zip_path, "--activate", check=False)
        models.log_site(slug, "info", f"Plugin premium installé : {zip_name}")

    if config.NOVAMIRA_PRO_LICENSE:
        activate_novamira_pro_license(site, config.NOVAMIRA_PRO_LICENSE)
    else:
        models.log_site(slug, "warn", "NOVAMIRA_PRO_LICENSE absent du .env")

    provision_mcp(site)
